relations.subject: Rajendralal Mitra
relations.evidence: Mitra was appointed librarian-cum-assistant-secretary of the Asiatic Society in April 1846. He held the office for nearly 10 years, vacating it in February 1856.

relations.subject: Rajendralal Mitra
relations.evidence: and in 1885 Mitra became the first Indian president of the Asiatic Society.
